text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Over 1,000 flu patients registered in Skopje. Actual number of ill much higher because not everyone seeks medical help. Health ministry recommends avoiding large gatherings.
- Government owes 170,325,000 denars ($4 million) to tobacco producers who demand urgent payment. Rumours say government will rise price of kilo of tobacco to 82 denars from 73.
- Synod of the Macedonian Orthodox Church investigates possibility of Orthodox priests being incorporated in Macedonian army.
